notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Felidar Guardian.
You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 2.
